page.layout: One scanned page: the outside of a book cover in tan leather or vellum, with a library label pasted at the lower right. No printed text on the cover itself. The label carries library stamp text, which is not transcribed.
page.notes: The page is a blank book cover (binding), with no printed title, page number, running head or text. The only printed matter visible is the library label at the lower right, which reads partly "BIB..." and "W..." and a large purple letter "L", with dashed rules. This is a library stamp/label and is left out as required. Pink marks at the lower left and blue ink spots on the cover are stains or handling marks, not text. No transcription of content is possible.
